description: File up to 50 existing transcriptions into a folder, or pass folder_id: null to move them out of any folder. The folder must already exist and belong to the signed-in person — call list_folders for the ids. Passing more than 50 ids is refused, not truncated. Requires `login`.

folder_id.description: Target folder id, or null to remove them from any folder.

transcription_ids.description: Transcription ids to move. At most 50 per call.

name: move_to_folder
